adjudication_summary.note: After phase 2 training_history rows: the 5 six-year graduates and Villar count as COMPLETED; Ramanathan transferred; Dawoud left (destination unconfirmed).

problems: Program length changed: classes that entered through 2011 finished at PGY-6 (Neils/Karanth listed PGY-6 then 2013 alumni; Lee, Vasilakis, Vachhani, Issawi, Martinez each vanish right after PGY-6). The first PGY-7 seen is Johnson/MacMahon in 2019-20 (2013 entrants). The adjudicator uses 7 years, so it wrongly flags the 6-year graduates as LEFT. The alumni page was last archived in 2014-02 and lists graduates only up to 2013, so it confirms only Neils and Karanth (inserted into training_history). 2012-13 roster shows no PGY-1 (possibly no intern that year). Ramanathan's PGY label did not advance in 2015-16. Class sizes: 2 per year, except 1 in the 2011, 2014, 2017, 2019, 2024 and 2026 entry years. Stephanie Salovesh's photo files are named Menezes (name change). Common Crawl: every crawl from 2011 to 2020 finished. 4 failed index range requests (2016-07, 2017-39, 2018-51, 2020-29) were retried with ccscan_one and succeeded with 0 records. PHASE 2: the adjudicator uses one terminal PGY (7); the six-year graduates are closed by training_history rows. Villar (2012 entrant) also finished at PGY-6, so terminal_pgy_by_entry_year covers entry years through 2012 as 6.
terminal_pgy_note: Entrants through 2012 finished at PGY-6 (Lee 2014, Vasilakis/Vachhani 2015, Issawi 2016, Martinez 2017, and Villar 2018 - a 2012 entrant with intern year at UF, graduated June 2018 per NPPES). First PGY-7s: 2013 entrants Johnson/MacMahon in 2019-20.

2011-2012.reason: No roster capture anywhere (Wayback full-host audit, link audit, CC-MAIN-2012). Both sides observed (2009-10 page and Feb 2013): everyone on the 2009-10 list except the 2010 graduate Rammos reappears in 2012-13, and the 2010 and 2011 classes each show 1 entrant (Issawi, Martinez) in an era of 1-2 per year. Only a 2010/2011 entrant who left before Feb 2013 could be missed; no such name in PubMed 'Peoria' neurosurgery affiliations 2010-13.

2012-2013.reason: No PGY-1 listed (Feb 2013). The 2012 class entered Peoria at PGY-2 in 2013-14 (Villar: intern year at UF; Ramanathan: UW Seattle affiliation 2012-13). An unseen Peoria intern would have had to leave before Feb 2013.

2015-2016.reason: Bio-page nav May 2016 lists all 9; bracketed by complete 2014-15 and 2016-17 lists. Ramanathan's PGY-3 label repeated (last year before he left).

2018-2019.reason: No capture (Wayback full-host audit 2018-02..2020-01, link audit, CC 2018-19 overview only). Reconstructed 10: 8 bracketed + 2018 interns Ivankovic and Sommer (PGY-2 Feb 2020, 'Class of 2025'). Villar is not hidden here: he graduated June 2018. Class sizes (2018 entry: 2) match the complement, so only a person who both joined and left inside 2018-19 could be missed.

2019-2020.reason: Common Crawl copy of the residents page (Feb 2020), 11 names PGY1-7.

2020-2021.reason: Spring capture only (Apr 2021) but complete-looking and consistent with neighbours.
